page.overview:
Who is Zora Bennett?

Zora Bennett is a skilled covert operations expert and the main lead protagonist in . She is contracted to lead a skilled team on a top-secret mission to secure genetic material from the world's three most massive dinosaurs until her operation intersects with a civilian family.

Zora Bennett appears as a professional, strongly focused on the mission. However, she has also a strong sense of humor. She has close relations with her team especially with Duncan, as they understand each other's trauma. She still feels the grief of her friend's death. She seems to be primarily concentrated on her job and not in her private life. Despite working as a mercenary and ready to break certain rules, she does have a grew a conscience as she helps the Delgados despite the mission and even rejects the money by sharing the discovery with everyone. She shares a bond with Henry Loomis possibly over a shared sense of adventure.

Zora was a mercenary, with a background in MARSOC, that worked primarily worked in war-torn areas. Her and Booker were in a car in Yemen when a car bomb blew up. Booker slowly died. This memory has continued to hurt Zora, because Booker was a good friend of hers.

In the summer of 2027, Zora encountered Martin Krebs in New York. Whilst in traffic Bennett was able to sneak into Krebs’ car. The two talked about an upcoming mission that Krebs and his employer Parker-Genix Pharmaceutical Engineering had recruited Bennett for. Zora mentioned that they were meant to meet at another location. Bennett also said that Krebs wasn’t hard to follow. Eventually, Zora exited the vehicle and Krebs followed her after parking the car. They talked about a mission to Ile Saint-Hubert, a former InGen island. Krebs mentioned that the mission isn’t legal and they could face criminal prosecution. Martin said that a civilian is on the mission, although the civilian doesn’t know this yet. Krebs also mentions that Zora would be paid a high amount of money for the mission.
